newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: F&N falls on weaker earnings outlook.
newsitem.headline: F&N falls on weaker earnings outlook.

text.p: Soft drinks group Fraser & Neave Ltd shares shed 40 Singapore cents or 2.76 percent to S$14.10 on the back of poor earnings outlook, said dealers.
At 0840 GMT, the share was hovering at S$14.10 after touching a low of S$14.00 earlier. Volume was a moderately active 763,000 units.
On Friday, the group announced an 18-percent rise in earnings to S$218 million for the year ended September 30 1996.
It said property profits, which had been a sizeable contributer to group earnings, would fall by half in 1997.
DBS Securities downgraded F&N to a "reduce" from a "hold" recommendation previously.
"The selling is also expected as their core soft drinks operations did not do as well as expected. The group earnings were boosted mainly by property," said an analyst with a foreign broking firm.
She said the share price should see some support at around S$14. - Singapore Newsroom 65-8703080
